I also could not move the fake into M1-T27, the only later task that depends on both: M1-T26, which comes before M1-T27, also uses the fake. The Read types, the fake's path in Writes and the main.tsx acceptance (PL-12 and PL-14 route modules) were applied. Partly applied. I did not make M1-T13 to M1-T15 depend on M1-T12. Those tasks build against PitReader's frozen contract and its M1-T01 replay double, and M1-T12 delegates to the M1-T01 stubs, so no real input crosses between them. Adding the edges would also chain spine tasks together. The delegation invariant, the M1-T12 acceptance line and its Read types were applied.
